A '''Khil heirloom''' was a relic sacred to [[Belnar/Legends|Belnar's]] native [[Khil]] species. During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] the heirloom was stolen by a [[Unidentified Belnar Senator|Senator]], who was then tracked down by an investigator and tricked into confessing the crime.<ref>{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Investigation|Senatorial Search}}</ref>
